create_PositionalEncoding: create a PositionalEncoding module with sinusoidal positional encodings for a given embedding dimension and dropout rate
run_PositionalEncoding_forward: run the PositionalEncoding forward pass on a B x T x C input tensor to add positional encodings
create_RelPositionalEncoding: create a RelPositionalEncoding module with relative positional encodings supporting positive and negative relative positions
run_RelPositionalEncoding_forward: run the RelPositionalEncoding forward pass on a T x B x C input tensor to get relative positional embeddings
review_PositionalEncoding_extend_pe: review the PositionalEncoding extend_pe method that lazily generates and caches sinusoidal positional encoding tensors
